frontmatter.title: Tanium Platform Foundation (Beginner Edition)
frontmatter.description: Beginner-first walkthrough of the Tanium platform using plain language, analogies, and hands-on practice.
objectives: Explain Tanium's core value using a relatable analogy.
Identify key platform components and how they show up on the TCO exam.
Complete a first-success workflow in the Tanium console.
Apply the platform principles to troubleshoot a simple scenario.
